model_annotation: The line chart, titled “Издадени разрешения за строеж на нови сгради 2012 г. – 2022 г. По данни на НСИ” (Building Permits Issued for New Structures, 2012–2022, According to NSI Data), illustrates the annual number of building permits issued in Bulgaria from 2012 to 2022, categorized by building type: Administrative (blue line), Other (orange line), and Residential (gray line). The x-axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, labeled at one-year intervals. The y-axis, though unlabeled, represents the count of permits and ranges from approximately 3,900 to over 8,000, with major gridlines spaced at intervals of 500 units. The gray line (Residential) starts at 4,238 in 2012, dips to 4,120 in 2013, rises steadily to a peak of 8,169 in 2022. The orange line (Other) begins at 4,938 in 2012, declines to 4,323 in 2014, peaks at 5,562 in 2017, then falls to a low of 3,944 in 2020 before recovering to 4,631 in 2022. The blue line (Administrative) remains relatively low and stable, starting at 170 in 2012 and ending at 70 in 2022, with minor fluctuations between 95 and 187 over the period. The chart includes exact numerical labels for each data point on the orange and gray lines, while the blue line’s values are shown only at the bottom of the chart, beneath the x-axis.
